integrity: Proof includes an eight-state all-horizon invariant for three agents, an explicitly bounded exhaustive four-agent prefix recurrence, a complete five-chore adversarial branch tree, and a standalone exact-integer checker. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Identical unit-size chores, publicly observed nonempty eligibility sets, deterministic irrevocable assignment, adaptive adversarial arrivals, temporal eligibility-aware proportionality up to one chore. Does not assert results for variable sizes, general costs, or randomized allocation against oblivious input.
title: A sharp four-agent exception in online proportional allocation of unit chores
